record.title: Gaza de facto authorities restrict Erez access after assassination, March–April 2017
record.scope: Arba-Arba (4/4) checkpoint controlling access to Erez / Beit Hanoun
record.crossings: Arba-Arba (4/4) checkpoint controlling access to Erez / Beit Hanoun
record.direction: Initially both directions, then principally Gaza outward passengers
record.exceptions: Entry restored 26 March for Gaza ID holders and 27 March for others; exit categories changed. Kerem goods remained open.
record.imposing_authority: Hamas-led de facto authorities in Gaza
record.enforcement: Operational evidence as specified in source notes; uniform enforcement beyond this crossing/scope is not inferred.
record.consequences: OCHA recorded 102 referred patients missing medical appointments by 6 April.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence in cited sources only; no present-status inference.
record.official_rationale: Gaza authorities cited security following the killing of a Hamas member on 24 March.
record.context: Separate Gaza-side prohibition layered over Israeli Erez permit controls.
record.uncertainty: 6 April source reports announced removal; does not independently establish every passenger category crossed that day. Included as control of a named frontier access route, not an ordinary internal checkpoint.
